raw_segments.text: Midia got up and went to the window. The rain lashed against its little greenish panes.
He could see the muddy road just below the house and farther away in the rain and mist,
a row of poor, black, dismal huts looking even blacker and poorer in the rain. Midia
thought of Phobos the Golden-haired, and how he had meant to shoot himself at his first
Perhaps it would be even better on a morning like this, he thought with a smile, and suddenly,
flinging his hand downwards, he turned to his torturers.
